findings.title: A timed-out upload shows a generic sign-in error and invites a duplicate retry
findings.body: `execFile` is called with `timeout: 30_000`. On timeout, Node kills `gh` and the callback gets an error with empty stderr, so line 16 rejects with "GitHub request failed. Check your GitHub CLI sign-in and repository access.". The POST may already have been received by GitHub, so the artifact may exist on the issue. The message points the user at sign-in and access, and a retry can attach a second copy. The PR description says "If the upload outcome is unclear, check the issue before retrying", but no code or i18n key in this PR shows that message (no `issueArtifact.*` key mentions it). Detect `error.killed`/`signal` for the POST case and reject with a distinct message telling the user to check the issue before retrying, or drop the claim from the PR description.

findings.title: Publish result is not checked to be a URL before the dialog reports success
findings.body: `gh api --jq .html_url` prints `null` when the response has no `html_url`, and an empty string if output is empty. `publishIssueArtifact` returns `result.trim()` unchecked. The dialog then shows "Added to GitHub issue" and a "View on GitHub" button (GitHubIssueArtifactDialog.tsx:74) whose `openExternal` call is rejected by `openAllowedAppExternalURL` (frontend/src/main/external-open.ts:22-25). The rejection is dropped by `void`, so the button does nothing and no message is shown. Validate that the result is an `https://github.com/` URL and otherwise throw, or hide the button when it isn't one.

findings.title: The title-search path and its repository filter are untested
findings.body: The only `findArtifactIssues` test covers the number lookup of a pull request. The `search/issues` branch (lines 33-38 of github-issue-artifact.ts) is not exercised. It holds the check that drops results from other repositories when the user's query contains `repo:`/`org:` qualifiers, and the check that drops pull requests. A regression there would let a user pick an issue from a repository other than the one shown. `publishIssueArtifact` is also untested for gh failures (rejection message, EPIPE). Add a case where the search returns an item with a different `repository_url` and one with `pull_request`, and assert only the matching issue is returned.

findings.title: Raw `<label>` and a hard-coded id from another dialog
findings.body: The repository label is a bare `<label htmlFor="cloneRepositoryUrl">`, relying on the id hard-coded inside `GitHubRepoPicker` (GitHubRepoPicker.tsx:109), which `CloneRepositoryDialog` also uses (CloneRepositoryDialog.tsx:376,400). Duplicate ids appear if both are mounted, and the label silently stops working if the picker's id changes. CloneRepositoryDialog uses the shadcn `Label` primitive; CLAUDE.md asks new UI to use `components/ui/*` where one fits. Use `Label`, and give the picker an `id` prop rather than reusing its constant.
